title: Semantic Economy: Measurement Specifications Technical Standards for Quantifying Meaning-Flows
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A v1.0 internal technical specification by Lee Sharks proposing nine measures for Semantic Economy research and audit.

The measures cover semantic labor, semantic capital, semantic liquidation, provenance loss, debt, coherence, and integrity markers: Time-Use Semantic Density, Affective Return on Investment, Terminological Authority Index, Coherence Persistence Index, Semantic Decay Delta, Provenance Erasure Rate, Semantic Debt Ratio, Integrity Knot Test, and Semantic Integrity Marker Survival Rate. The document supplies formulas, examples, scales, and suggested uses. These are framework-internal proposals, not recognized technical standards, validated scientific instruments, calibrated economic measures, or ready-made clinical metrics. Several variables require qualitative judgment, and some comparison signs appear lost or malformed in the rendered body.
